Policy H3 Residential extensions
Extensions to dwellings are supported where the proposal respects the
scale, form and materials of the host building and the character of the
street. Rear extensions should not exceed a depth of 4.0 m for terraced
dwellings or 6.0 m for detached dwellings unless the applicant shows that
no material loss of daylight or outlook results to a neighbouring room.
Side extensions are set back from the front elevation and keep a minimum
1.0 m gap to the side boundary where a terracing effect would otherwise
occur. Off-street parking is assessed against Table 2 of the Design SPD,
which sets the minimum spaces by bedroom count and accessibility.
Proposals that remove a parking space must show that the replacement
provision meets that table or that the site lies within Zone A.

Dwelling size | Minimum spaces | Cycle spaces | Note
1 bedroom | 1 | 1 | Zone A: 0
2-3 bedrooms | 2 | 2 | see note 2
4+ bedrooms | 3 | 2 | Tandem spaces count once
Note 2: within 400 m of a frequent bus stop the standard reduces by 1 space.
